title: Java Object-Oriented Programming
description: A practical course covering classes, objects, inheritance, encapsulation, and GUI-based Java development.

lessons.title: Classes and Objects
lessons.content: Introduction to object-oriented programming using Java classes, objects, attributes, and methods.

quiz.question: What is an object in Java?

lessons.content: Using inheritance to reuse code and polymorphism to handle different object types through common interfaces.

lessons.title: Java Swing GUI Design
lessons.content: Building desktop interfaces using JFrame, buttons, tables, text fields, and event handling.

quiz.question: Which Java library is commonly used for desktop GUI components?

title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: An introductory course covering security principles, access control, secure authentication, and basic incident response.

lessons.title: Access Control Basics
lessons.content: Understanding authentication, authorization, user permissions, and role-based access.

lessons.title: Security Operations
lessons.content: Introduction to monitoring, incident response, risk management, and system hardening.

title: Cloud and IoT Integration

lessons.title: Cloud Data Storage
